task: Predict disease-specific survival in endometrial carcinoma using discretized time bins. Each case is assigned to one of four time bins from early to late follow-up with censored or disease-specific death status. H&E features linked to worse disease-specific outcome include high-grade nuclear atypia, serous morphology, solid growth, deep myometrial invasion, lymphovascular invasion, and tumor necrosis.

classes.0: Earliest time bin, censored — short disease-specific follow-up without death from endometrial carcinoma.
classes.1: Second time bin, censored — intermediate-short follow-up without disease-specific death.
classes.2: Third time bin, censored — intermediate-long follow-up without disease-specific death.
classes.3: Fourth time bin, censored — longest follow-up without disease-specific death.
classes.4: Earliest time bin, event — disease-specific death occurred early, consistent with aggressive endometrial carcinoma morphology.
classes.5: Second time bin, event — disease-specific death occurred at an intermediate-early timepoint.
classes.6: Third time bin, event — disease-specific death occurred at an intermediate-late timepoint.
classes.7: Fourth time bin, event — disease-specific death occurred late after prolonged follow-up.
